summary: Ran full backend + frontend E2E validation for TeraPlayer. 14/14 pytest backend tests passed against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, and all 5 Playwright frontend flows passed (paste input, error panel on invalid URL, history drawer, favorites drawer, theme toggle Dark->Light removes 'dark' class on <html>).

minor.issue: When 'url' query is missing FastAPI returns 422 rather than 400 (test accepts both). Not a real bug but spec asked for 400.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') - migrate to lifespan context manager in future.
Rate limiter is per-worker in-memory (dict + deque). Fine for single-worker dev but will reset per gunicorn worker and per pod restart. Consider Redis-backed limiter for production.
_extract_via_hnn and _extract_via_teradl call third-party workers that go down frequently - already handled gracefully via try/except and native fallback returns ok=false.
extractors.py resolve_terabox is well-structured with clear fallback chain (hnn -> teradl -> wdzone -> native metadata). Good defensive coding.

History POST is idempotent (updates existing) but returns HistoryEntry with a NEW id every time even when a matching row already exists - the DB row keeps its original id (because we only $set fields from the new obj). Minor: this means the returned id may not match the persisted id. Consider returning the existing row on match.
GET /api/stream forwards Range headers correctly and streams via httpx - solid implementation.
test_credentials: None required - session_id is generated by client (localStorage teraplayer.session_id).
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates and cleans up its own TEST_-prefixed session ids in MongoDB collections history/favorites.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://stream-terabox.preview.emergentagent.com. All P0 flows validated. Third-party TeraBox extractors (hnn/teradl/wdzone) may not resolve real links from this pod - tests only assert well-formed ok=false payload for invalid/dead URLs (never 500). If you need to test a real TeraBox link end-to-end use a known-good share URL and check that /api/preview returns ok=true with a stream_url; then hit /api/stream?url=<stream_url> and verify HTTP 200/206 with content-type video/*.
